verdict.rationale: Poly documents sharing a file or folder in-app with "anyone with a link", which is a basic form of publishing selected notes from inside the app. Nothing shows that it renders notes as a browsable website or digital garden, or that links between notes work for viewers. Missing for 10: website/digital-garden rendering of published notes, working inter-note links on the published view, selective publish controls beyond link sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
